Vue's other directives, for a template

Source: R/vue_directives.R
directives.Rd

Attributes for a tag in a Vue template – a vue_app()'s, el$ and vtags tags, a slot, a table cell – given as an unnamed argument, as Vue writes them: tags$li(v_for("item in items", key = "item.id"), "{{ item.name }}") is <li v-for="item in items" :key="item.id">. The expressions are Vue's, evaluated in the component's scope – its data, setup(), a slot's scope – and the page's names ($vueStore, $inputs, $route). Nothing else in the tag is touched; the backtick attributes they stand for – `v-if` = "ok" – work as well.

Usage

v_if(expr)

v_else_if(expr)

v_else()

v_show(expr)

v_for(expr, key = NULL)

v_slot(name = "default", scope = NULL)

v_html(expr)

v_text(expr)

v_once()

v_pre()

v_memo(deps)

v_directive(name, value = NULL, arg = NULL, modifiers = NULL)

Arguments

expr

A JavaScript expression, a string.

key

For v_for(), the expression of each item's key: :key.

name

For v_slot(), the slot's name; for v_directive(), the directive's, without v-.

scope

For v_slot(), the slot's props as a destructuring pattern: "{ row }".

deps

For v_memo(), an array expression: "[item.id]".

value, arg, modifiers

For v_directive(), the parts of v-name:arg.modifiers="value".

Value

Attributes for a tag, as an unnamed argument.

Details

With them, v_bind(), v_model() and v_on() work in a template too: as a named argument's value, el$space(size = v_bind("size")) is :size="size", el$input(value = v_model("text")) is v-model:value="text"; unnamed, v_bind("attrs") is v-bind="attrs" and v_model("text") is v-model="text". An R value given to v_bind() is a literal: el$select(options = v_bind(df)).

Outside a template a directive means nothing, and drawing one says so.

See also

Other directives: v_on()

Examples

vue_app(
  "todo",
  htmltools::tags$div(
    htmltools::tags$input(v_model("draft"), v_on("keyup.enter" = "add()")),
    htmltools::tags$ul(
      htmltools::tags$li(v_for("t in todos", key = "t"), "{{ t }}")
    ),
    htmltools::tags$p(v_if("!todos.length"), "Nothing yet"),
    htmltools::tags$p(v_else(), "{{ todos.length }} to do")
  ),
  data = list(draft = "", todos = list()),
  methods = list(
    add = JS("function() { this.todos.push(this.draft); this.draft = ''; }")
  )
)
#> <div id="todo" data-shiny-vue style="display: contents">
#>   <script type="text/x-template" data-shiny-vue-template><div>
#>   <input v-model="draft" @keyup.enter="add()"/>
#>   <ul>
#>     <li v-for="t in todos" :key="t">{{ t }}</li>
#>   </ul>
#>   <p v-if="!todos.length">Nothing yet</p>
#>   <p v-else>{{ todos.length }} to do</p>
#> </div></script>
#>   <script type="application/json" data-shiny-vue-options>{"options":{"data":{"draft":"","todos":[]},"methods":{"add":"function() { this.todos.push(this.draft); this.draft = ''; }"}},"evals":["options.methods.add"]}</script>
#> </div>
